item.title: Go P2P Development: From Basics to PubSub
item.description:
Go’s simple concurrency model and fast compilation make it a popular choice for P2P network development. go-libp2p is one of the most complete libp2p implementations and is widely used in large projects like IPFS (Kubo).

Environment Setup

The first draft of this post was written in 2023; the code has been updated as versions evolved and currently targets go-libp2p v0.35 (released May 2024) with Go 1.21. Around v0.22, go-libp2p split its interfaces into a separate go-libp2p/core module, so the go-libp2p-core imports found in older tutorials fail to compile outright — pinning the version is step one.
